question: for each centre show the average turnout rate in both years next to each other
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre

WITH attendance_2023 AS (
  SELECT "Centre", "Month", "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment, "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance
  FROM "attendance_2023"
),
attendance_2024 AS (
  SELECT "centre_name" AS Centre, "month" AS Month, "enrolment", "average_attendance"
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    Centre, 
    Month, 
    enrolment, 
    average_attendance,
    LEAD(enrolment, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY Centre ORDER BY Month) AS next_enrolment,
    LEAD(average_attendance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY Centre ORDER BY Month) AS next_average_attendance
  FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Centre ORDER BY Month) AS rn
    FROM combined
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  Centre,
  Month,
  ROUND(CAST(average_attendance * 100.0 / NULLIF(enrolment, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "2023 Turnout Rate (%)",
  ROUND(CAST(next_average_attendance * 100.0 / NULLIF(next_enrolment, 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "2024 Turnout Rate (%)"
FROM combined
ORDER BY Centre, Month;
